title: Indonesia Biofuels & Biodiesel Intelligence
definitions: Installed biodiesel/FAME manufacturing capacity is NOT crude-oil refining throughput; 2025 biodiesel output is NOT 2026 consumption. B50 blend refers to diesel product blending, not an ethanol mandate.

installed_capacity.source_type: Attributed EBTKE official speaking to ANTARA, 5 Feb 2026
installed_capacity.caveat: Aggregate manufacturing capacity, not certified operating throughput or a plant-by-plant audited inventory. Active commissioned capacity by plant pending verification.

plants.caveat: Number of nominated businesses is not number of manufacturing plants; no unverified site nameplate data are shown.
plants.locations_note: Clustered around palm oil processing hubs, notably Sumatra and Kalimantan; a verified 2026 plant-by-plant nameplate/province register is still a data gap.

actuals_2025.caveat: Government publications separately report 14.2m kL against an internal KPI indicator; 14.94m kL is EBTKE's physical distribution against annual allocation, not the same measurement.

history_note: 2021–24 government 'pemanfaatan' series from Jan 2026 ESDM release, 2025 is EBTKE distributor record; methodological distinction precludes precise audited year-on-year claim.

actuals_2026.status: Attributed official EBTKE statement in Commission XII hearing; non-audited media-reported interim figure
actuals_2026.note: The 10.69m kL is biodiesel/FAME volume distributed, not total blended diesel volume.

allocation.planning_status: Government estimated full-year volume upon phased B40→B50; NOT presented as revised signed operator-specific allocation
allocation.target_2026_other_note: September committee briefing reportedly used 16.7m kL target. Do not combine with June 17.6m forecast or original 15.646m allocated volume without confirming latest legal instrument.

rollout.note: Count refers to service stations reached, not evidence of sustained quality at each location.

diesel_market.note: Total finished diesel market baseline; cannot equate one-to-one with the bio-component volume.

feedstock.upstream_dependency: Competition for palm oil with food, oleochemicals and exports; feedstock demand depends on yield and process efficiencies, not a naive 1:1 CPO-to-FAME conversion.
feedstock.risk: CPO supply and weather, land-use sustainability, export levy revenues, terminal blending logistics, fuel specs, machinery compatibility

stats_2026.attribution: GAPKI/industry estimate, not an ESDM audited FAME kL figure
stats_2026.caveat: Tonnes of palm oil supply/feedstock are not equivalent to kiloliters of FAME biodiesel; do not add or compare numerically without validated conversion yields.

ethanol.status: E20 discussed/planned; not evidenced as nationwide implemented mandate as of this dataset date
ethanol.consistency_warning: ESDM's June 2026 statement said 4m kL for E20, while 12 October 2026 revised the stated E20 requirement to about 8m kL, consistent with 20% of a 40m kL fuel market under simple volume assumptions. These are programme estimates, NOT verified commissioned supply.
ethanol.roadmap: E10 targeted from 2027, then E20 around 2028–29; potential longer-run E50 under study, no nationwide legal mandate verified.
ethanol.alternative_pilots: Sorgum manis pilot in DIY & NTT; Arenga palm processing in Kamojang (reported 1,000 L/day; site-specific pilot, not national industry capacity).

price.warning: October 2026 biodiesel HIP Rp15,072/L EXCLUDES transport charge. Bioethanol HIP Rp8,062/L remains a June 2026 reference; each has a different as-of date. Neither is a retail pump price.

policies.name: B50 mandatory blending
policies.note: Staged terminal and service-station rollout; compliance needs verification.

policies.name: Initial 2026 B40 volume allocation
policies.status: Original allocation; review effect of B50 revisions
policies.note: 15.646m kL baseline must not be called revised B50 allocation.

policies.name: Biodiesel producer incentive arrangements
policies.note: BPDP financing and price differential; not blanket subsidy for every liter.

policies.name: Bioethanol product specification
policies.status: Specification announced April 2026; not E20 rollout proof
policies.note: Standards distinct from binding nationwide E20 blending obligation.

policies.name: E20 gasoline ethanol ambition
policies.note: Four million kL ethanol stated requirement conflicts with simple market-wide 20%-of-40m kL arithmetic; planning basis needs clarification.

policies.name: October 2026 biodiesel price index (HIP)
policies.instrument: EBTKE October 2026 HIP release; based on Kepmen ESDM 3.K/EK.05/DJE/2024
policies.status: Published official monthly reference; freight extra
policies.note: Rp15,072/L plus applicable transport; not retail fuel price.

policies.name: E10 bioethanol implementation roadmap
policies.status: Target E10 2027; E20 2028–29; E50 discussed, no nationwide mandate confirmed
policies.note: October E20 quoted need 8m kL vs June 4m; verify enacted roadmap and funding.

assessment: Nominal 22m kL/year FAME production capacity appears above June 17.6m kL demand estimate, but no operational headroom should be inferred without verified utilization and regional throughput.
B50 substitution can reduce imported finished diesel, but concentration in palm oil feedstock can shift vulnerability upstream to agronomy, input pricing and logistics.
2026 biodiesel volume data are incomplete as of 7 September; year-to-date distribution cannot be interpreted as final-year consumption.
Risk concentration: BPDP funding balance, export-levy sensitivity, engine/fuel quality, terminal blending transition, CPO food-versus-fuel competition and land-use impacts.

Bioethanol E10 remains planned for 2027 and E20 later; ESDM quoted ~8m kL E20 need in October, but active industrial-scale ethanol capacity, delivered fuel volumes, and binding implementation rules require verification.

saf.type: Bioavtur / Sustainable Aviation Fuel (SAF), distinct from palm FAME biodiesel

current.facility: Pertamina Cilacap TDHT / co-processing, Central Java
current.status: Reported current operational-unit capacity; not audited annual SAF output

expansion.status: Project target; NOT currently operating at 887 kL/day

other_projects.status: 2026 project launch / groundbreaking mentioned by ESDM; no verified commissioning or annual fuel-ethanol nameplate

saf.note: Do not aggregate daily SAF processing/production capacity (kL/day) with annual FAME production capacity (million kL/year) or crude refining capacity (bpd). SAF may use UCO and co-processing rather than FAME.
